- When sentiment is positive (≥0.2) in recent days, model tends to overestimate prices; reduce forecast slightly.
- After a sharp price spike (e.g., +5+ in 3-5 days), model often overshoots in next 5-7 days; cap forecast at +3-5% above peak.
- If sentiment is neutral or negative (0.0), model underestimates; add 1-2% to forecast to align with mean reversion.
- Model consistently underestimates in early 30d horizon when sentiment is low; apply 1.5-2% upward bias for first 5-7 days.
- If recent 3-5 day price trend is upward, model often fails to capture momentum; increase forecast by 1-2% for next 3-5 days.
- Model shows lag in reacting to sentiment shifts; delay forecast adjustment by 1-2 days if sentiment changes abruptly.
- When sentiment is high and price is rising, model tends to overreact; apply downward bias of 0.5-1.5% for next 3-5 days.
- If model forecast is >10% above true outcome for 3 consecutive days, reduce forecast by 1-2% per day until convergence.
